problem_type: Whether a canvas node kind takes input / has referenceable output had no owner, so every connection entry guessed it differently
symptom: Left 「+」 on a video card greys out 图片 / 文字 (its main inputs); left 「+」 on a text card creates a meaningless image → text edge; a plain click on 「+」 does nothing; uploaded asset and text cards show a left 「+」 that cannot be used.
direct_cause: createVerdictsForStart (useGenerationCanvasReactFlowMenus) always judged the started card as the SOURCE even on the left side, while connectToNode makes the new node its UPSTREAM; validateReferenceEdge returned ok for any target without a model archetype (asset, text, clip, director...); the source handle had no click handler and connectOnClick was false; the visual contract mounted both rings on every kind.
class_root: The node-kind definitions (nodes/registry.ts) declared what a kind generates but not what it takes in or gives out, so rings, the left menu, the connection gate and the clip node each inferred it on the spot.
affected_population: Every canvas user connecting nodes by ring click, ring drag to blank space, drop on a card, canvas pick, @-mention, auto-reference, group links or Agent connect_nodes
Old projects that already hold edges into asset / text cards (they keep loading; new ones are refused)
entry_points: Ring drag released on blank space → handleConnectEnd → connectionMenuVerdicts
Ring drag released on a card → completeNodeConnection → connectToNode → resolveCanvasReferenceConnection → validateReferenceEdge
Canvas pick mode → pickCanvasInputFor → canConnectInput / connectExistingInput
@-mention of a canvas node → useNodeMentionSource → validateReferenceEdge
Group input links → groupInputLinks / materialization → validateReferenceEdge

external_sources.purpose: Confirms a pointer down on a handle only starts a connection after moving past dragThreshold (default 1px), so a plain click never reaches onConnectStart / onConnectEnd and needs its own click handler (bug ①).

invariants: Every node kind declares connects.input ('models' | asset list | false) and connects.output; the type makes it mandatory.
A ring exists on a side only when that side can be used (getGenerationNodeConnectionSides reads connects).
Left-side verdicts judge the card as TARGET (connectionCreateVerdictsForTarget); right-side as SOURCE.
No NEW edge into a kind with connects.input === false passes validateReferenceEdge; existing edges are never deleted by this gate.

door_reduction.why_not: The six doors are six genuinely different user / agent gestures (agent connect, plan partition, edge-mode menu, manual / menu / pick connection, @-mention, auto-reference). They already converge on one function; the fix moved the missing fact into that function (via the kind definition) instead of adding a seventh check, so the count stays and every door inherits the rule.

generality_proof: The fact lives on the kind definition and is read by validateReferenceEdge, the single function all six edge-creation doors call, plus by the ring contract and both menu verdict functions. A new caller that creates edges through any of these doors cannot bypass it; a new node kind cannot be added without declaring connects (TypeScript error).

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Single declaration of what each node kind takes in and gives out.
Refuses new edges into kinds that take no input and enforces asset lists for clip / director.
Left-ring verdicts judged with the card as target, sharing reasons with the right-ring verdicts.
Ring existence per side, read from the kind definition.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Replaces createVerdictsForStart; left side calls connectionCreateVerdictsForTarget (connectionMenuModel.test.ts).
Calls validateReferenceEdge; manual drop, ring menu, recipes and pick mode all reach it through connectToNode.
Calls validateReferenceEdge per member; groupInputLinks.test.ts now reports target_takes_no_input for text members.
Clip's own upstream reader (image / video results) is now declared as connects.input ['image','video'] instead of being inferred from 'no archetype = accept all'.
The main-process MCP connect path never ran validateReferenceEdge (pre-existing gap of the wider class, not introduced here); it cannot import the renderer registry. Recorded in residual_risks.

recurrence.reason: Any new entry (the coming @ → canvas node pick, new node kinds) would otherwise infer input / output again; the clip node was already a second inference site.
same_class_scan: node scripts/door-map.mjs validateReferenceEdge → 6 write doors, all converge

node scripts/door-map.mjs connectNodes → 17 write doors; system provenance edges (panorama screenshot → asset, director / clip / whiteboard outputs) use store.connectNodes without the gate and are intentionally untouched
git grep providesImageReference / referenceAssetKindForNode → referenceAssetKindForNode now gated by connects.output

prevention.invariant: Every node kind declares connects; rings, both menu verdicts, recipes and validateReferenceEdge read it.
prevention.failure_mode: A missing declaration is a compile error; a new edge into a kind that takes no input is refused with target_takes_no_input and user-visible feedback.
prevention.strategy: Move the fact to the earliest shared place (the kind definition) and make the existing single gate read it.

legacy_paths.rationale: createVerdictsForStart (side-blind verdicts) deleted; unused showFlowConnectionHandle deleted; the specimen's RECEIVES_WITHOUT_ARCHETYPE list and DOM overrides deleted with the lab kit rewrite; the old-behaviour comparison states deleted.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: xyflow behaviour (dragThreshold) is used as documented; the click handler is ours. No dependency change.

migration: No data migration. Old edges into kinds that no longer take input keep loading and rendering (target handles stay mounted, hidden source handles stay mounted for anchoring) and can be disconnected; only new ones are refused.
residual_risks: electron/capabilityCore/canvasGraph.ts connectNodes (external MCP connect) still has no capability gate at all; enforcing connects there needs the kind facts in a main-process-readable layer.
test:canvas:performance not run on this Windows line (unverified).

invariant_owner_layer.why: The plugin definitions are the single declaration of node kinds; connects is a required field there, and every reader goes through getGenerationNodeDefinition.

structural_evidence.behavior_preservation: Right-ring verdicts and copy are unchanged (connectionCreateVerdictsForSource untouched); referenceAssetKindForNode returns the same asset for every kind that had one (connects.output is true exactly for the kinds it returned non-null for, plus text which still returns null); image / video / generation targets validate exactly as before. Changed on purpose (user decision 10-08): rings disappear on unusable sides, the left menu judges the card as target, new edges into kinds that take no input are refused, plain click on a ring opens its menu.
structural_evidence.verification_limits: Unit tests, typecheck, i18n and design-lab structure ran on Windows; the real-Electron walk canvas-handle-menus ran headless off-screen on Windows (zh / en / dark). test:canvas:performance and macOS were not run on this line.
